verdict.rationale: Firstbase's own registered-agent page says that to expand to a new state you just select the state on the compliance dashboard and "we'll take care of it for you." A per-state compliance dashboard with requirements and actions backs this up, so the provider itself handles the new-state registration. The support is a single short marketing claim that never uses the term foreign qualification or describes the filing in detail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the foreign-qualification filing (scope, timelines, pricing, registered agent in the new state), independent or hands-on corroboration.
